evolutionary strategy called Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) which efficiently explores the high-dimensional solution space while handling constraints. Unlike previous
strategies, CMA-ES maintains a probability distribution over the search space and adapts it based on selection and gradient information, leading to faster convergence. We start from the provided parent
solution and perform local optimization around its best complement formulation (BCF) to escape local optima. The central idea is to modify the parent's structure slightly to break symmetry-induced overlaps
while maintaining the integral constraint and bounds.
